public_rationale: He says the underlying economics "suggest" that no subscription-based AI service "makes any kind of financial sense." The statement is hedged and gives a judgment, not a measurable fact. It names no metric, threshold, set of services or period. "Financial sense" could mean gross margin, contribution margin, operating profit or long-run viability, and the statement does not say which. The resolution contract does not turn hedged language into a firm claim about profitability. So the statement cannot be scored as worded.
limitations: The packet contains no evidence items. The one source considered, an Alphabet results release, was not used.
This assessment does not address whether any specific AI subscription service is profitable.
